g.title: KayaRank1Convo1 begins.
g.text: KayaRank1Convo1 begins.

g.title: j2871206983
g.text: Hi. Can everybody time travel, or just you?

g.title: j3942430961
g.text: Good day to you too, listen kid, it’s not that simple.

g.title: j3528886670
g.text: Hello? Kaya? How is your day.

g.title: j3364877932
g.text: I'm not a kid. I'm 19.

g.title: j3619260307
g.text: Fine.

g.title: j3859531922
g.text: Right. Youngest of this new group I'd say, though, kid.

g.title: j3954318070
g.text: Yeah yeah, just don't rush into the time travel thing. It's... complicated.

g.title: j1710701234
g.text: So. Just you? Are there others? Is time travel taught in schools in the future?

g.title: j3361339688
g.text: Ugh. Youngest, sure, but also clearly most intent on doing something to find answers. Try and keep up. So: Time travel. How and who?

g.title: j3262348257
g.text: Ugh. How complicated? Formulas? Chemical and atomic elements? I'll figure it out just point me in a direction.

g.title: j3019316111
g.text: Let's say it's just me. Keeps it simpler.

g.title: j143046502
g.text: And why you? Do you have a plan?

g.title: j194801737
g.text: I don't really know what to tell you. It's not just the realm of science, or if it is, it's a science that Entrati knows.

g.title: j317738574
g.text: Here's a direction: Stop [End.]

g.title: j1730610389
g.text: As for teaching in schools, if it was I didn't study it. But it might have been?

g.title: j2870595315
g.text: And if not, what can you recommend so I can get any scientific sources on your abilites?

g.title: j1198731927
g.text: Ugh that bastard. I knew I should have asked him more questions. Ok. At least if it's science, it means I can reproduce it, and since you can come and go, I can figure it out. Bye.

g.title: j466595356
g.text: Why, want some homework? Time travel is probably too advanced for now...

g.title: j510229508
g.text: So many questions, kid. Hate to break it to you but: I don't know. Only Entrati has the answers.

g.title: j2547432773
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j70736456
g.text: Ugh, are you serious?

g.title: j2507192691
g.text: Boolean KayaSetKid is now true.

g.title: Initiate conversation HexKayaConvo1 in HexDialogue_rom.dialogue
g.text: Queue conversation HexKayaConvo1 in HexDialogue_rom.dialogue

g.title: j3567266033
g.text: Have any of the Hex figured it out? Do they have any info?

g.title: j216897697
g.text: K.

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank1Convo2.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank1Convo2.

g.title: Initiate conversation HexKayaConvo1 in HexDialogue_rom.dialogue->Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank1Convo2.
j1825952152
g.text: Maybe Amir? He probably plays games with time travel plots...

g.title: j789279494
g.text: Don't think so, kid. But if you want to learn something useful, ask Lettie for a 101 on healing.

g.title: j825606714
g.text: Boolean KayaAmirTravel is now true.

g.title: j821946656
g.text: Boolean KayaLettieHeal is now true.

g.title: j2498719124
g.text: Games? I just need answers, a direction, anything. I'll figure it out. If you think of anything HELPFUL, find me.

g.title: j518506763
g.text: Not my style. Whatever.
